title: A Card for Mr. Amos

readiness.reading: choosing and reading words to write a card

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mr. Amos hurt his hand with a hammer. It will mend, but it's sore, and he can't work for a few days.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A card would cheer him up. Choose a word for each coloured space.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.prompt: Write the card: choose a word for each coloured space.
lines: I am sorry your hand is {hurt}.
I am {feel} that your hand is {hurt}.
I will {help} until it is better.

feedback.all_good: What a kind card. Take it to Mr. Amos at his workshop.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The card is ready. Kind words help hurts to heal.

journal_line: I made a get-well card for Mr. Amos.
unavailable_text: The card for Mr. Amos is made.
